cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've highlighted the transfer in green like you. All sorted. Let's keep our anniversary booking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Green means pending. Is that our savings going to your sister again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pending until Friday. It's a banking complication. Last time we argued about my sister, you moved into the spare room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call the bank and ask what the complication is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me sort it. Please don't cancel dinner before I've got the money back.

reason: Remove yes that could accidentally answer the concealed-loan question; keep a confident adoption of corrected status and the stated fear of conflict.
